entries.englishValue: Bitcoin doesn't have inflation
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin har ingen inflation

entries.englishValue: Inflation means your money buys you less over time. Bitcoin is better money because it doesn't have inflation.
entries.targetTranslation: Inflation betyder, at dine penge kan købe mindre over tid. Bitcoin er gode penge, fordi det ikke har inflation.

entries.englishValue: because it has a maximum supply of 21 million Bitcoin. No one can print more Bitcoin.

entries.englishValue: Dollars have an unlimited supply, which means more can be printed at any time.
entries.targetTranslation: Udbuddet af australske dollar er ubegrænset, hvilket betyder, at der kan udskrives flere når som helst.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is scarce
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin er knappe

entries.englishValue: Historically, Bitcoin has gained purchasing power over time while the dollar has lost it. Many people use Bitcoin as their long-term savings account: money that they can leave alone and let grow for several years.
entries.targetTranslation: Historisk set har Bitcoin fået købekraft over tid, mens australske dollar har mistet købekraft. Mange bruger Bitcoin som en langsigtet opsparingskonto — penge, som de lader vokse i årevis uden at røre dem.

entries.englishValue: Would you rather save in dollars that buy you less over time? Or save in Bitcoin that has historically bought you more over time?
entries.targetTranslation: Vil du hellere spare op i australske dollars, der køber mindre over tid? Eller i Bitcoin, som historisk har købt mere over tid?

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is also a tool for freedom
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin er også et frihedsværktøj

entries.englishValue: The Bitcoin network isn't owned by anyone. It isn't controlled by any government or corporation. It's designed to uphold your freedom and protect your money.
entries.targetTranslation: Ingen kontrollerer Bitcoin-netværket. Ingen regering eller virksomhed driver det. Det er bygget til at beskytte din frihed og dine penge.

entries.englishValue: People around the world are already using Bitcoin to protect their freedom — even when their own governments refused to help or tried to stop them.
entries.targetTranslation: Mennesker verden over bruger allerede Bitcoin til at forsvare deres frihed — selv når deres regeringer nægter at hjælpe dem eller forsøger at stoppe dem.

entries.englishValue: If you save in Australian Dollars, you've probably noticed that they buy you less each year. It takes more dollars to buy the same amount of food. You need more dollars to maintain your quality of life.
entries.targetTranslation: Hvis du sparer op i australske dollars, har du sikkert bemærket, at du kan købe mindre for dine penge hvert år. Du har brug for flere australske dollars for at købe samme mængde varer. Du har brug for flere australske dollars for at opretholde din levestandard.

entries.englishValue: But it doesn't have to be this way.
entries.targetTranslation: Men sådan behøver det ikke være.

entries.englishValue: People who saved in Bitcoin over the last 4 years saw life get cheaper.
entries.targetTranslation: I løbet af de seneste fire år har de, der sparer op i Bitcoin, oplevet, at livet bliver billigere.

entries.englishValue: Here's the proof: your money is losing value
entries.targetTranslation: Her er beviset: dine penge mister værdi

entries.englishValue: The dollars in your bank account buy you less every year. That's because there is no fixed limit on how many dollars can be created.

entries.englishValue: This unlimited supply is the root cause of inflation. Over recent years, the total amount of dollars in existence has increased dramatically.
entries.targetTranslation: Denne ubegrænsede forsyning er hovedårsagen til inflation. I løbet af de seneste år er antallet af australske dollars i omløb steget dramatisk.

entries.englishValue: When more money is created from nothing, the price of everything goes up. This includes the raw materials that companies buy to make their products — which means higher prices for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Når der skabes flere penge ud af den blå luft, stiger priserne på alt. Det gælder også de råvarer, virksomheder køber for at fremstille produkter — hvilket fører til højere priser for dig.

entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin er det mest sikre computernetværk, der nogensinde er bygget, og er aldrig blevet hacket. CBDC'er er afhængige af banker og regeringer, som er blevet hacket utallige gange.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is designed to give you total control over your money.
entries.englishValue: Nobody can stop you from transacting with Bitcoin. CBDCs are designed so governments and central banks can control every payment, limiting your privacy and freedom.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin er designet til at give dig total kontrol over dine penge.
entries.targetTranslation: Ingen kan forhindre dig i at transagere med Bitcoin. CBDC'er er designet til, at regeringer og centralbanker kan kontrollere hver betaling, hvilket begrænser dit privatliv og din frihed.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin never expires and has no monthly fees.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin never expires and has no monthly fees. CBDCs can be programmed to expire, preventing you from saving for the future.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin udløber aldrig og har ingen månedlige gebyrer.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin udløber aldrig og har ingen månedlige gebyrer. CBDC'er kan programmeres til at udløbe, hvilket afskrækker dig fra at spare op til fremtiden.

entries.englishValueBefore: CBDCs, much like the government currencies we use today, have no cap on total supply. This lack of cap on total supply allows the government to expand the money supply.

entries.currentValue: CBDC'er har, ligesom de statsvalutaer vi bruger i dag, ingen grænse for det samlede udbud. Denne mangel på grænse for det samlede udbud lader myndighederne udvide pengemængden.
entries.targetTranslation: inflation.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin addresses are pseudonymous, which means they are not linked to your real name or identity. CBDCs are directly linked to your real name and identity which enables massive financial surveillance and censorship.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin addresses aren't tied to your real identity. CBDCs link directly to government ID, enabling mass financial surveillance and censorship.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin-adresser er pseudonyme, hvilket betyder, at de ikke er knyttet til dit rigtige navn eller identitet. CBDC'er er direkte knyttet til dit rigtige navn og identitet, hvilket muliggør massiv finansiel overvågning og censur.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin-adresser er ikke bundet til din reelle identitet. CBDC'er er direkte knyttet til statsligt udstedt ID, hvilket muliggør masseovervågning og censur af finanser.

entries.englishValueBefore: The Bitcoin network is decentralized.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's rules are validated by tens of thousands of independent nodes. CBDCs are centralized in government and central-bank hands, which hold complete control over the network.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin-netværket er decentraliseret.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoins regler verificeres af titusindvis af uafhængige noder. CBDC'er er centraliseret hos regeringer og centralbanker, som har fuld kontrol over netværket.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin allows anyone to run a node that verifies the rules of the network are being followed. CBDCs don't allow anyone to run nodes and rely on trust in the government and central banks.
entries.englishValue: Anyone can run a Bitcoin node to verify the rules of the network. CBDCs don't allow users to run nodes — you have to trust the central authority.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin lader enhver køre en node, der verificerer, at reglerne i netværket følges. CBDC'er lader ingen køre noder og er afhængig af tillid til myndighederne og centralbanker.
entries.targetTranslation: Enhver kan køre en Bitcoin-node og verificere netværkets regler. CBDC'er tillader ikke brugere at køre noder — du skal stole på en central myndighed.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is designed to make it impossible for others to freeze your money. CBDCs are designed to make it easy for governments and central banks to freeze your money.
entries.englishValue: Self-custodied Bitcoin can't be frozen by anyone. CBDCs are designed so governments and central banks can freeze accounts instantly.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin er designet til at gøre det umuligt for andre at fryse dine penge. CBDC'er er designet til at gøre det nemt for myndigheder og centralbanker at fryse dine penge.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin i selvforvaring kan ikke fryses af nogen. CBDC'er er designet, så regeringer og centralbanker kan fryse konti øjeblikkeligt.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin gives you full control over your money when you self-custody it with a
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin er designet til at give dig fuld kontrol over dine penge.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin giver dig fuld kontrol over dine penge, når du selv opbevarer det i en

entries.englishValueBefore: Just make sure you withdraw it to a self-custody wallet.
entries.englishValue: wallet.
entries.currentValue: Bare sørg for at trække ud til en selvopbevarende wallet.
entries.targetTranslation: wallet.

entries.englishValueBefore: When you self-custody your bitcoin, no one can stop you from accessing your money.
entries.englishValue: CBDCs require trusting custodians like banks or governments to hold your money for you.
entries.currentValue: Når du selvopbevarer din bitcoin, kan ingen stoppe dig fra at få adgang til dine penge.
entries.targetTranslation: CBDC'er kræver tillid til depotholdere som banker eller regeringer, der opbevarer pengene for dig.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a predictable monetary policy that is fixed in code and can't be changed. CBDCs, like our currencies today, have a monetary policy that can easily be changed.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's monetary policy is fixed in code and can't be changed. CBDCs can be reprogrammed at will by politicians, causing
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin har en forudsigelig pengepolitik, der er fastlagt i kode og ikke kan ændres. CBDC'er har, som vores valutaer i dag, en pengepolitik, der nemt kan ændres.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoins pengepolitik er låst fast i kode og kan ikke ændres. CBDC'er kan omprogrammeres efter politikeres ønske, hvilket forårsager

entries.englishValueBefore: This results in inflation when politicians print too much money.
entries.englishValue: inflation
entries.currentValue: Dette resulterer i inflation, når politikere trykker for mange penge.
entries.targetTranslation: inflation

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin's protocol has remained fundamentally unchanged since 2009, providing predictable rules that cannot be easily altered. Most crypto projects frequently update their protocols, change tokenomics, or fork into new versions, creating uncertainty for users.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's protocol has stayed fundamentally the same since 2009, providing predictable rules. Most crypto projects constantly change protocols, tokenomics, or fork into new versions.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoins protokol er forblevet fundamentalt uændret siden 2009 og giver forudsigelige regler, der ikke nemt kan ændres. De fleste kryptoprojekter opdaterer deres protokoller hyppigt, ændrer tokenøkonomi eller forgrener sig til nye versioner, hvilket skaber usikkerhed for brugerne.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin-protokollen er stort set uændret siden 2009 og giver forudsigelige regler. De fleste kryptoprojekter ændrer konstant protokoller, tokenomics eller splitter sig i nye versioner.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a truly decentralized network with tens of thousands of independent nodes worldwide. Many crypto projects are controlled by foundations, companies, or small groups of developers who can make unilateral decisions about the protocol's future.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin runs on tens of thousands of independent nodes worldwide. Most crypto projects are controlled by foundations, companies, or small dev teams that can make unilateral changes.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin fungerer på et virkelig decentraliseret netværk med titusindvis af uafhængige noder over hele verden. Mange kryptoprojekter kontrolleres af stiftelser, virksomheder eller små grupper af udviklere, der kan træffe ensidige beslutninger om protokollens fremtid.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin kører på titusindvis af uafhængige noder verden over. De fleste kryptoprojekter styres af fonde, virksomheder eller små udviklerteams, der kan foretage ensidige ændringer.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million coins that will ever exist, making it the scarcest digital asset. Most crypto projects have unlimited supplies, inflationary mechanisms, or can mint new tokens at will, diluting holder value over time.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million coins — the scarcest digital asset. Most crypto projects have unlimited supplies or mechanisms to mint new tokens at will, diluting holders.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin har en hård grænse på 21 millioner mønter, der nogensinde vil eksistere, hvilket gør det til det knappeste digitale aktiv. De fleste kryptoprojekter har ubegrænset udbud, inflationsmekanismer eller kan præge nye tokens efter ønske, hvilket udvander ejernes værdi over tid.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin har et fast loft på 21 millioner mønter — det sjældneste digitale aktiv. De fleste kryptoprojekter har ubegrænset forsyning eller mekanismer til at skabe nye tokens vilkårligt, hvilket udvander ejerne.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has one simple purpose: peer-to-peer digital money. Anyone can understand and use it with basic knowledge. Many crypto projects involve complex smart contracts, DeFi protocols, or governance mechanisms that require technical expertise to use safely.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has one purpose: peer-to-peer digital money. Anyone can understand and use it. Most crypto involves complex smart contracts or DeFi that require technical expertise to use safely.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin har ét enkelt formål: peer-to-peer digitale penge. Alle kan forstå og bruge det med grundlæggende viden. Mange kryptoprojekter involverer komplekse smart contracts, DeFi-protokoller eller styringsmekanismer, der kræver teknisk ekspertise for at bruge sikkert.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin har ét formål: peer-to-peer digitale penge. Alle kan forstå og bruge det. De fleste kryptoer involverer komplekse smart contracts eller DeFi, der kræver teknisk viden for at bruges sikkert.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin uses Proof of Work consensus, which has been battle-tested for over 15 years without a single successful attack on the main network. Many crypto projects use experimental consensus mechanisms like Proof of Stake or delegated systems that haven't proven their long-term security.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's Proof of Work has run without a successful attack on the main network for over 15 years. Most crypto projects use experimental consensus that hasn't been battle-tested.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin bruger Proof of Work-konsensus, der er kamphærdet i over 15 år uden et eneste vellykket angreb på hovednetværket. Mange kryptoprojekter bruger eksperimentelle konsensusmekanismer som Proof of Stake eller delegerede systemer, der ikke har bevist deres langsigtede sikkerhed.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoins Proof of Work har kørt uden et succesfuldt angreb på hovedkæden i over 15 år. De fleste kryptoprojekter bruger eksperimentel konsensus, der ikke er grundigt afprøvet.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin serves as digital money - a store of value and medium of exchange. Most crypto tokens are utility tokens for specific platforms, governance tokens, or speculative assets with unclear real-world value propositions.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is digital money — a store of value and medium of exchange. Most crypto tokens are speculative utility or governance tokens with unclear real-world value.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin fungerer som digitale penge – et værdiopbevaringsmiddel og byttemiddel. De fleste kryptotokens er utility-tokens for specifikke platforme, styringstokens eller spekulative aktiver med uklare virkelige værdiforslag.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin er digitale penge — et værdilager og byttemiddel. De fleste kryptotokens er spekulative utility- eller governance-tokens med uklar virkelighedsværdi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin becomes stronger under attack and has survived every crisis, ban, and criticism thrown at it. Most crypto projects are fragile and can collapse from regulatory pressure, technical failures, or market downturns.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin grows stronger under attack and has survived every crisis, ban, and criticism. Most crypto projects collapse under regulatory, technical, or market pressure.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin bliver stærkere under angreb og har overlevet enhver krise, forbud og kritik, der er blevet kastet mod det. De fleste kryptoprojekter er skrøbelige og kan kollapse under regulatorisk pres, tekniske fejl eller markedsnedgange.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin bliver stærkere under angreb og har overlevet enhver krise, ethvert forbud og enhver kritik. De fleste kryptoprojekter falder sammen under regulativt, teknisk eller markedsmæssigt pres.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has no CEO, no company behind it, and no single point of failure. Many crypto projects are backed by venture capital firms, have identifiable leadership teams, or depend on specific companies for their continued operation.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no CEO, no company, no single point of failure. Most crypto projects depend on VCs, specific leadership, or one company's survival.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin har ingen administrerende direktør, ingen virksomhed bag sig og intet enkelt fejlpunkt. Mange kryptoprojekter er støttet af venturekapitalfirmaer, har identificerbare ledelsesteam eller er afhængige af specifikke virksomheder for deres fortsatte drift.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin har ingen CEO, virksomhed eller enkelt failure-punkt. De fleste kryptoprojekter afhænger af VC-investorer, specifik ledelse eller en enkelt virksomheds overlevelse.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is perfectly fungible, meaning every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable - one bitcoin equals one bitcoin anywhere in the world. Fine art is non-fungible by nature, with each piece being unique in its creation, history, condition, and provenance, making direct comparisons and valuations extremely difficult.
entries.englishValue: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable. Every artwork is unique — different creation, history, condition, and provenance make direct comparisons extremely difficult.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin er perfekt fungibelt, hvilket betyder, at hver bitcoin er identisk og udskiftelig – én bitcoin er lig med én bitcoin hvor som helst i verden. Kunst er ikke-fungibel af natur, med hvert stykke unikt i sin skabelse, historie, tilstand og proveniens, hvilket gør direkte sammenligninger og værdiansættelser ekstremt vanskelige.
entries.targetTranslation: Hver bitcoin er identisk og ombyttelig. Hvert kunstværk er unikt — forskellig oprindelse, historie, tilstand og proveniens gør direkte sammenligning ekstremt vanskelig.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin trades on a global 24/7 market where anyone with internet access can buy or sell instantly. Fine art requires specialized auction houses like Sotheby's or Christie's, private dealers, or exclusive galleries. Sales can take months to arrange and complete, with limited market access and irregular trading opportunities.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades 24/7 on a global market accessible to anyone. Fine art requires specialized auction houses, private dealers, or galleries and can take months to sell.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin handles på et globalt 24/7-marked, hvor enhver med internetadgang kan købe eller sælge øjeblikkeligt. Kunst kræver specialiserede auktionshuse som Sotheby's eller Christie's, private forhandlere eller eksklusive gallerier. Salg kan tage måneder at arrangere og gennemføre, med begrænset markedsadgang og uregelmæssige handelsmuligheder.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin handles 24/7 på et globalt marked, der er tilgængeligt for alle. Billedkunst kræver specialiserede auktionshuse, private handlere eller gallerier, og salg kan tage måneder.

entries.englishValueBefore: Buying or selling bitcoin typically costs less than 1% in fees, often much less. Fine art sales involve substantial costs including buyer's premiums (10-25%), seller's commissions (10-15%), insurance, transportation, storage, and authentication fees. These combined costs can easily exceed 30-40% of the artwork's value in a single transaction.
entries.englishValue: Buying or selling Bitcoin costs under 1% in fees, often much less. Art sales rack up 30–40% in buyer's premiums, commissions, insurance, transport, and authentication fees.
entries.currentValue: At købe eller sælge bitcoin koster typisk mindre end 1% i gebyrer, ofte meget mindre. Kunstsalg involverer betydelige omkostninger inklusive køberpræmier (10-25%), sælgerprovision (10-15%), forsikring, transport, opbevaring og autentificeringsgebyrer. Disse kombinerede omkostninger kan nemt overstige 30-40% af kunstværkets værdi i en enkelt transaktion.
entries.targetTranslation: At købe eller sælge Bitcoin koster mindre end 1 % i gebyrer, ofte langt mindre. Kunstsalg stabler 30-40 % op i buyer's premiums, kommissioner, forsikring, transport og autentificeringsgebyrer.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be divided into 100 million smaller units called satoshis, making it perfect for transactions of any size from microtransactions to large purchases. Fine art cannot be divided - you cannot own a fraction of a painting or sell just part of a sculpture. This indivisibility limits investment flexibility and liquidity options.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats, making it perfect for any size transaction. You can't own a fraction of a painting or a corner of a sculpture without counterparty risk.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin kan deles i 100 millioner mindre enheder kaldet satoshis, hvilket gør det perfekt til transaktioner af enhver størrelse fra mikrobetalinger til store køb. Kunst kan ikke deles – du kan ikke eje en brøkdel af et maleri eller sælge kun en del af en skulptur. Denne udelelighed begrænser investeringsfleksibilitet og likviditetsmuligheder.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin kan deles op i 100 millioner satoshi, hvilket gør det ideelt til transaktioner af enhver størrelse. Du kan ikke eje en del af et maleri eller et hjørne af en skulptur uden modpartsrisiko.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin ownership and authenticity can be cryptographically verified on the blockchain by anyone with basic technical knowledge. Fine art requires expensive expert authentication, provenance research, and scientific analysis. Even with expert verification, forgeries regularly fool the art world, and authentication disputes can destroy an artwork's value overnight. Bitcoin, on the other hand, cannot be forged or counterfeited.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin ownership and authenticity can be cryptographically verified by anyone on-chain. Art authentication is expensive, slow, and still routinely fooled by forgers — destroying an artwork's value overnight.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin-ejerskab og ægthed kan kryptografisk verificeres på blockchainen af enhver med grundlæggende teknisk viden. Kunst kræver dyr ekspertautentificering, proveniensforskning og videnskabelig analyse. Selv med ekspertverificering narrer forfalskninger regelmæssigt kunstverdenen, og autentificeringstvister kan ødelægge et kunstværks værdi over natten. Bitcoin kan derimod ikke forfalskes.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin-ejerskab og ægthed kan verificeres kryptografisk af enhver på blockchainen. Autentificering af kunst er dyrt, langsomt og bliver regelmæssigt narret af forfalskere — hvilket ødelægger et værks værdi fra den ene dag til den anden.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin, when backed up properly, cannot be destroyed by floods, fires, earthquakes, hurricanes, theft, or other disasters. Fine art is vulnerable to all forms of physical destruction and deterioration. Even with expensive climate-controlled storage and comprehensive insurance, artworks can be damaged by environmental factors, accidents, or natural disasters, potentially losing all value.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin, backed up properly, survives floods, fires, earthquakes, and theft. Fine art is vulnerable to every form of physical destruction, and insurance rarely covers it all.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin kan, når det er sikkerhedskopieret korrekt, ikke ødelægges af oversvømmelser, brande, jordskælv, orkaner, tyveri eller andre katastrofer. Kunst er sårbar over for alle former for fysisk ødelæggelse og forringelse. Selv med dyr klimakontrolleret opbevaring og omfattende forsikring kan kunstværker blive beskadiget af miljøfaktorer, ulykker eller naturkatastrofer og potentielt miste al værdi.
entries.targetTranslation: Korrekt backuppet Bitcoin overlever oversvømmelser, brande, jordskælv og tyveri. Billedkunst er sårbar over for alle former for fysisk ødelæggelse, og forsikring dækker sjældent alt.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be bought and sold by anyone with internet access and a small amount of money to invest. Fine art investment is largely limited to wealthy collectors due to high minimum prices, exclusive auction access, storage requirements, insurance costs, and the specialized knowledge needed to navigate the art market successfully.
entries.englishValue: Anyone with an internet connection and a little money can buy Bitcoin. Fine art investment is effectively limited to wealthy collectors with auction access and specialized knowledge.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin kan købes og sælges af enhver med internetadgang og et lille beløb at investere. Kunstinvestering er i stor grad begrænset til velhavende samlere på grund af høje minimumspriser, eksklusiv auktionstilgang, opbevaringskrav, forsikringsomkostninger og den specialiserede viden, der kræves for at navigere kunstmarkedet med succes.
entries.targetTranslation: Alle med internetforbindelse og lidt penge kan købe Bitcoin. Kunstinvestering er praktisk talt begrænset til velhavende samlere med adgang til auktioner og specialiseret viden.

entries.englishValueBefore: Because Bitcoin is digital, it can be sent almost instantly for very low fees by anyone with an Internet connection. Because Gold is physical, it cannot be moved across the Internet and must be physically shipped to transfer ownership.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin can be sent instantly over the internet for low fees. Gold must be physically shipped to transfer ownership.
entries.currentValue: Fordi Bitcoin er digitalt, kan det sendes næsten øjeblikkeligt med meget lave gebyrer af alle med internetadgang. Fordi guld er fysisk, kan det ikke flyttes over internettet og skal sendes fysisk for at overføre ejerskab.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin kan sendes øjeblikkeligt via internettet til lave gebyrer. Guld skal fysisk sendes for at overføre ejerskab.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a digitally native asset, which means you can transfer full ownership of it over the Internet. Some companies offer the ability to buy gold online without receiving the actual physical gold, instead trusting the company to hold the gold for you. This is more like a Digital IOU since you only own a promise from the company instead of the actual asset.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a digitally native asset you can transfer over the internet. Online gold is a Digital IOU — you only own a promise from a custodian, not the metal itself.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin er et digitalt oprindeligt aktiv, hvilket betyder, at du kan overføre fuldt ejerskab over internettet. Nogle virksomheder tilbyder muligheden for at købe guld online uden at modtage det faktiske fysiske guld, men i stedet stole på, at virksomheden opbevarer guldet for dig. Dette er mere som et digitalt gældsbrev, da du kun ejer et løfte fra virksomheden i stedet for det faktiske aktiv.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin er et digitalt født aktiv, som du kan overføre via internettet. Online guld er en digital IOU — du ejer kun et løfte fra en depotholder, ikke selve metallet.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million BTC. Gold's supply grows about 1.6% per year, shrinking your slice — less than fiat
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin har en hård grænse på 21 millioner BTC, der nogensinde vil eksistere.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin har et fast loft på 21 millioner BTC. Guldforsyningen vokser med omkring 1,6 % om året, hvilket skrumper din andel — mindre end fiat-

entries.englishValueBefore: New gold supply is pulled out of the ground each year, resulting in inflation of the total supply. It's estimated that the total supply of gold increases by about 1.6% per year, which means your slice of the pie shrinks by 1.6% per year.
entries.englishValue: inflation
entries.currentValue: Nyt guldudbud hentes ud af jorden hvert år, hvilket resulterer i inflation af det samlede udbud. Det anslås, at det samlede udbud af guld stiger med cirka 1,6% om året, hvilket betyder, at din del af kagen skrumper med 1,6% om året.
entries.targetTranslation: inflation

entries.englishValueBefore: This is less than fiat inflation, but still inflation.
entries.englishValue: — but still inflation.
entries.currentValue: Dette er mindre end fiat-inflation, men det er stadig inflation.
entries.targetTranslation: , men stadig inflation.

entries.englishValueBefore: Gold has an elastic supply, meaning that as the price of gold rises, there is a greater incentive to mine more gold. This often puts downward pressure on the gold price as new mines come online.
entries.englishValue: When gold prices rise, more gold gets mined, pushing the price back down. Bitcoin's supply is inelastic — no matter how high the price goes, there will only ever be 21 million.
entries.currentValue: Guld har et elastisk udbud, hvilket betyder, at når guldprisen stiger, er der større incitament til at mine mere guld. Dette lægger ofte nedadgående pres på guldprisen, når nye miner åbnes.
entries.targetTranslation: Når guldpriserne stiger, bliver der udvundet mere guld, hvilket presser prisen ned igen. Bitcoins forsyning er uelastisk — uanset hvor højt prisen stiger, vil der altid kun være 21 millioner.

entries.englishValueBefore: The Bitcoin network is decentralized.
entries.englishValue: Tens of thousands of independent nodes validate the Bitcoin network. Most physical gold sits in a handful of large custodian vaults.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin-netværket er decentraliseret.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin-netværket verificeres af titusindvis af uafhængige noder. Det meste fysiske guld sidder i nogle få store depoter.

entries.englishValueBefore: With Bitcoin, it's incredibly easy to verify that you have real Bitcoin by taking self-custody of your coins and running a full node.
entries.englishValue: Anyone can verify real Bitcoin by running a full node — it's just an app. Verifying physical gold requires melting it down; the inside could be tungsten.
entries.currentValue: Med Bitcoin er det utroligt nemt at verificere, at du har ægte Bitcoin ved at selvopbevare dine mønter og køre en fuld node.
entries.targetTranslation: Enhver kan verificere ægte Bitcoin ved at køre en fuld node — det er bare en app. Verificering af fysisk guld kræver, at det smeltes om; der kunne være wolfram indeni.

entries.englishValueBefore: Just like there are 100 cents in 1 dollar, there are 100,000,000 sats in 1 Bitcoin. This enables Bitcoin to be used for all scales of purchases, including microtransactions as small as a few cents.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats, making it perfect for any size purchase. Gold can't be easily divided for small transactions.
entries.currentValue: Ligesom der er 100 øre i 1 krone, er der 100.000.000 sats i 1 Bitcoin. Dette gør, at Bitcoin kan bruges til alle størrelser af køb, inklusive mikrotransaktioner så små som et par øre.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin kan deles op i 100 millioner satoshi, hvilket gør det ideelt til køb af enhver størrelse. Guld kan ikke let opdeles til mindre transaktioner.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be moved anywhere in the world instantly over the internet. Real estate is permanently fixed to a specific location and cannot be relocated, making it vulnerable to local economic conditions, natural disasters, and political instability.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin moves anywhere in the world instantly. Real estate is fixed to one location and exposed to local economic, political, and natural risks.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin kan flyttes hvor som helst i verden øjeblikkeligt over internettet. Fast ejendom er permanent bundet til en specifik placering og kan ikke flyttes, hvilket gør det sårbart over for lokale økonomiske forhold, naturkatastrofer og politisk ustabilitet.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin flytter sig øjeblikkeligt overalt i verden. Fast ejendom er fastlåst til ét sted og udsat for lokale økonomiske, politiske og miljømæssige risici.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be divided into 100 million smaller units called satoshis, making it perfect for transactions of any size. Real estate cannot be easily divided - you can't sell just the kitchen of your house or buy half a bedroom.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats. Real estate can't be partly sold — you can't offload just the kitchen or buy half a bedroom.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin kan deles i 100 millioner mindre enheder kaldet satoshis, hvilket gør det perfekt til transaktioner af enhver størrelse. Fast ejendom kan ikke nemt deles – du kan ikke sælge kun køkkenet i dit hus eller købe halvdelen af et soveværelse.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin kan deles op i 100 millioner satoshi. Ejendom kan ikke delvist sælges — du kan ikke sælge et køkken eller købe et halvt soveværelse.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network that no government can control. Real estate is subject to extensive government regulation including rent control, eviction moratoriums, zoning laws, and eminent domain where governments can seize your property.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network that no government can control. Real estate is heavily regulated — zoning, rent control, eminent domain, and seizure all apply.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin fungerer på et decentraliseret netværk, som ingen myndighed kan kontrollere. Fast ejendom er underlagt omfattende myndighedsregulering inklusive huslejeregulering, moratorier på udsættelse, zonelove og ekspropriation, hvor myndigheder kan beslaglægge din ejendom.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin fungerer i et decentraliseret netværk, som ingen regering kan kontrollere. Fast ejendom er stærkt reguleret — zoning, huslejekontrol, ekspropriation og beslaglæggelse anvendes alle sammen.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin requires no maintenance - it exists as digital code on a network. Real estate requires constant upkeep including repairs, renovations, property management, insurance, and dealing with tenants if rented.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin requires no upkeep. Real estate demands repairs, renovations, insurance, property management, and tenant issues.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin kræver ingen vedligeholdelse – det eksisterer som digital kode på et netværk. Fast ejendom kræver konstant vedligeholdelse inklusive reparationer, renoveringer, ejendomsforvaltning, forsikring og håndtering af lejere, hvis det udlejes.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin kræver ingen vedligeholdelse. Fast ejendom kræver reparationer, renoveringer, forsikring, ejendomsadministration og håndtering af lejerproblemer.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has no ongoing taxes - you only pay capital gains when you sell. Real estate is subject to annual property taxes that must be paid regardless of whether the property generates income, effectively forcing you to rent your own property from the government forever.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no ongoing taxes — you only pay capital gains when you sell. Real estate owes annual property taxes regardless of income.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin har ingen løbende skatter – du betaler kun kapitalgevinstskat, når du sælger. Fast ejendom er underlagt årlig ejendomsskat, der skal betales uanset om ejendommen genererer indkomst, hvilket effektivt tvinger dig til at leje din egen ejendom af myndighederne for altid.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin er ikke underlagt løbende skatter — du betaler kun kapitalgevinstskat, når du sælger. Fast ejendom betaler årlig ejendomsskat uanset indkomst.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin, when backed up properly, cannot be destroyed by floods, fires, earthquakes, hurricanes, or other natural disasters. Real estate is vulnerable to all forms of physical destruction and requires expensive insurance that may not fully cover losses.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin, backed up properly, survives fire, flood, and earthquake. Real estate is vulnerable to every disaster, and insurance rarely covers it all.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin kan, når det er sikkerhedskopieret korrekt, ikke ødelægges af oversvømmelser, brande, jordskælv, orkaner eller andre naturkatastrofer. Fast ejendom er sårbar over for alle former for fysisk ødelæggelse og kræver dyr forsikring, der måske ikke fuldt dækker tab.
entries.targetTranslation: Korrekt backuppet Bitcoin overlever brande, oversvømmelser og jordskælv. Fast ejendom er sårbar over for enhver katastrofe, og forsikring dækker sjældent alt.

entries.englishValueBefore: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable - one bitcoin equals one bitcoin anywhere in the world. Every piece of real estate is unique with different locations, conditions, and characteristics, making it difficult to price and compare properties.
entries.englishValue: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable. Every property is unique, making pricing and comparisons difficult.
entries.currentValue: Hver bitcoin er identisk og udskiftelig – én bitcoin er lig med én bitcoin hvor som helst i verden. Hver ejendom er unik med forskellige placeringer, tilstande og egenskaber, hvilket gør det svært at prissætte og sammenligne ejendomme.
entries.targetTranslation: Hver bitcoin er identisk og ombyttelig. Hver ejendom er unik, hvilket gør værdiansættelse og sammenligning vanskelig.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be bought and sold 24/7 by anyone with internet access anywhere in the world. Real estate sales are limited to local buyers, require lengthy processes with lawyers and agents, and can take months to complete.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades globally 24/7 by anyone with internet access. Real estate sales are limited to local buyers and can take months of paperwork to close.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin kan købes og sælges 24/7 af enhver med internetadgang hvor som helst i verden. Ejendomssalg er begrænset til lokale købere, kræver langvarige processer med advokater og ejendomsmæglere og kan tage måneder at gennemføre.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin handles globalt 24/7 for alle med internetadgang. Ejendomssalg er begrænset til lokale købere og kan tage måneder at lukke med papirarbejde.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin enables direct individual ownership without intermediaries, promoting financial sovereignty for everyone. Buying real estate as an investment beyond your primary residence contributes to the financialization of housing, treating homes as commodities rather than shelter. This drives up prices, reduces affordability for families, and contributes to the housing and homelessness crisis affecting many countries today.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin enables direct individual ownership for anyone. Buying real estate as an investment beyond your primary residence drives up housing prices, reducing affordability and fueling the housing crisis.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin muliggør direkte individuelt ejerskab uden mellemmænd og fremmer finansiel suverænitet for alle. At købe ejendom som investering ud over din primære bolig bidrager til finansialiseringen af bolig, hvor boliger behandles som handelsvarer i stedet for husly. Dette driver priserne op, reducerer overkommeligheden for familier og bidrager til bolig- og hjemløshedskrisen, der påvirker mange lande i dag.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin muliggør direkte individuelt ejerskab for enhver. Køb af fast ejendom som investering ud over primærbolig presser boligpriserne op, reducerer boligtilgængelighed og skaber boligkrise.

entries.englishValueBefore: When you own Bitcoin, you have direct ownership of the asset itself. When you own stocks, you own a share of a company, which means your investment depends on the company's performance, management decisions, and business success.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a direct asset you own outright. Stocks are shares in a company — their value depends on management, performance, and decisions you can't control.
entries.currentValue: Når du ejer Bitcoin, har du direkte ejerskab til selve aktivet. Når du ejer aktier, ejer du en andel af en virksomhed, hvilket betyder, at din investering afhænger af virksomhedens resultater, ledelsesbeslutninger og forretningssucces.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin er et direkte aktiv, du ejer fuldstændigt. Aktier er andele i et selskab — deres værdi afhænger af ledelse, præstation og beslutninger, du ikke kontrollerer.

entries.currentValue: Dette er mindre end fiat-inflation, men det er stadig udvanding.
entries.targetTranslation: udvander kontanter. Med Bitcoin skrumper din andel aldrig.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network with no single point of failure. Stock investments are subject to key person risk - if the CEO or other critical leaders leave, get sick, or make poor decisions, your investment can suffer significantly. Companies depend heavily on their leadership teams.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no CEO and no single point of failure. Stocks depend heavily on leadership — one bad decision or departure can tank the price.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin fungerer på et decentraliseret netværk uden noget enkelt fejlpunkt. Aktieinvesteringer er udsat for nøglepersonrisiko – hvis administrerende direktør eller andre vigtige ledere stopper, bliver syge eller træffer dårlige beslutninger, kan din investering lide betydeligt. Virksomheder er stærkt afhængige af deres ledelsesteam.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin har ingen CEO eller enkelt failure-punkt. Aktier afhænger stærkt af ledelse — én dårlig beslutning eller en nøgleperson, der forlader selskabet, kan trække prisen ned.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin's price is determined purely by market supply and demand. Stock prices are often evaluated using P/E ratios (Price-to-Earnings), which show how much investors pay for each dollar of company earnings. High P/E ratios can indicate overvalued stocks, making it harder to determine fair value.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's price comes from open global markets. Stock valuations rely on metrics like P/E ratios that can mask overpriced shares.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoins pris bestemmes udelukkende af markedets udbud og efterspørgsel. Aktiepriser evalueres ofte ved hjælp af P/E-forhold (pris-til-indtjening), der viser, hvor meget investorer betaler for hver dollar af virksomhedens indtjening. Høje P/E-forhold kan indikere overvurderede aktier, hvilket gør det sværere at bestemme den rigtige værdi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoins pris kommer fra åbne globale markeder. Aktievurdering bygger på metrikker som P/E-forhold, der kan skjule overvurderede aktier.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin trades 24 hours a day, 7 days a week on global exchanges.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades 24/7 around the world. Stock markets are only open during business hours on weekdays.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin handles 24 timer i døgnet, 7 dage om ugen på globale børser.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin handles 24/7 verden over. Aktiemarkeder er kun åbne på hverdage i handelstiden.

entries.englishValue: of Bitcoin with a simple app — no broker needed. Stocks sit with brokerages, exposing you to counterparty risk if they fail.
entries.currentValue: Aktier kræver en mæglerkonto, og du er udsat for modpartsrisiko – hvis virksomheden går konkurs eller mægleren fejler, kan du miste din investering.
entries.targetTranslation: med en simpel app — ingen mægler nødvendig. Aktier ligger hos mæglervirksomheder, hvilket udsætter dig for modpartsrisiko, hvis de krakker.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a fixed supply asset with a hard cap of 21 million Bitcoin that will ever exist. This makes it a great inflation hedge. Stocks have variable performance against inflation - some companies do well during inflationary periods while others struggle. There's no guarantee that any particular stock will protect against inflation.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's fixed supply makes it a reliable inflation hedge. Some stocks beat inflation, others don't — there's no guarantee.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin er et aktiv med fast udbud med en hård grænse på 21 millioner Bitcoin, der nogensinde vil eksistere. Dette gør det til en fremragende inflationsbeskyttelse. Aktier har variabel ydeevne mod inflation – nogle virksomheder klarer sig godt i inflationsperioder, mens andre kæmper. Der er ingen garanti for, at nogen bestemt aktie vil beskytte mod inflation.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoins faste forsyning gør det til en pålidelig inflationshedge. Nogle aktier slår inflation, andre gør ikke — der er ingen garanti.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is an open network that anyone can join and use without permission. Credit card networks like Visa are closed systems controlled by financial institutions that can deny access to anyone they choose.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is an open network anyone can join and use without permission. Visa is a closed system controlled by financial institutions that can deny access — especially to the unbanked and underbanked.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin er et åbent netværk, som enhver kan tilslutte sig og bruge uden tilladelse. Kreditkortnetværk som Visa er lukkede systemer kontrolleret af finansielle institutioner, der kan nægte adgang til hvem de vil.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin er et åbent netværk, som alle kan tilslutte sig uden tilladelse. Visa er et lukket system kontrolleret af finansielle institutioner, der kan nægte adgang — især for folk uden bankkonto eller med begrænset bankadgang.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a transparent blockchain where all transactions can be verified by anyone. Credit card networks operate as closed, proprietary systems where transaction details are hidden from public view.
entries.englishValue: Every Bitcoin transaction is on a public, auditable blockchain. Visa runs a closed, proprietary system where customers can't independently verify anything.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin fungerer på en transparent blockchain, hvor alle transaktioner kan verificeres af enhver. Kreditkortnetværk fungerer som lukkede, proprietære systemer, hvor transaktionsdetaljer er skjult for offentligheden.
entries.targetTranslation: Hver Bitcoin-transaktion ligger på en offentlig, verificerbar blockchain. Visa driver et lukket, proprietært system, hvor kunder ikke kan verificere noget uafhængigt.

entries.englishValueBefore: Credit card companies can freeze accounts, block transactions, or deny service at any time. Bitcoin cannot be frozen or controlled by any central authority.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin can't be frozen by any central authority. Visa can freeze accounts, block transactions, or deny service at any time.
entries.currentValue: Kreditkortselskaber kan fryse konti, blokere transaktioner eller nægte tjenester når som helst. Bitcoin kan ikke fryses eller kontrolleres af nogen central myndighed.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin kan ikke fryses af nogen central myndighed. Visa kan fryse konti, blokere transaktioner eller nægte service når som helst.

entries.englishValueBefore: Credit cards create debt that can accumulate high interest rates if not paid off quickly, sometimes exceeding 25% annually.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is final-settlement — you can only spend what you own. Credit cards create debt with interest rates often over 25% a year.
entries.currentValue: Kreditkort skaber gæld, der kan akkumulere høje renter, hvis den ikke betales hurtigt, nogle gange over 25% årligt.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin er endelig afregning — du bruger kun det, du ejer. Kreditkort skaber gæld med renter, der ofte overstiger 25 % om året.

entries.englishValueBefore: Learn how to properly account for Bitcoin payments in your business accounting.
entries.englishValue: A plain-English guide to accepting Bitcoin in your books — hybrid wallets, cost basis, capital gains, and when to call an accountant.
entries.currentValue: Lær hvordan du korrekt fører regnskab for Bitcoin-betalinger i din virksomhed.
entries.targetTranslation: En guide på enkelt dansk til at bogføre Bitcoin-betalinger — hybride wallets, kostpris, kapitalgevinster, og hvornår du skal ringe til din revisor.

entries.englishValueBefore: Accepting Bitcoin has many benefits like accepting payments with lower fees & getting more customers.
entries.englishValue: The simplest way to accept Bitcoin is with a hybrid wallet that automatically sells 100% of the Bitcoin you receive for dollars (or your local currency) the instant a payment comes in.
entries.currentValue: At acceptere Bitcoin har mange fordele, som at modtage betalinger med lavere gebyrer og få flere kunder.
entries.targetTranslation: Den nemmeste måde at modtage Bitcoin på er ved at bruge en hybrid wallet, der automatisk sælger 100 % af den modtagne Bitcoin til kroner (eller din lokale valuta), så snart betalingen kommer ind.

entries.englishValueBefore: If you use a Hybrid Wallet from our Wallet Guide and automatically sell 100% of the Bitcoin you receive for dollars, you don't need to make any changes to your current accounting.
entries.englishValue: With this setup, your books look exactly like they do today — the final number is in dollars, every time. No cost basis, no capital gains, no new spreadsheets.
entries.currentValue: Hvis du bruger en hybrid-wallet fra vores wallet-guide og automatisk sælger 100% af modtaget Bitcoin for dollar, behøver du ikke ændre noget i dit nuværende regnskab.
entries.targetTranslation: Med denne opsætning ser dit regnskab nøjagtigt ud, som det gør i dag — slutbeløbet er kroner hver gang. Ingen kostpris, ingen kapitalgevinster, ingen nye regneark.

entries.englishValueBefore: TRACKING YOUR COST BASIS
entries.englishValue: If you keep some Bitcoin: tracking your cost basis
entries.currentValue: SPOR DIN ANSKAFFELSESPRIS
entries.targetTranslation: Hvis du beholder noget Bitcoin: sporing af kostpris

entries.englishValueBefore: Tracking your cost basis is going to be the biggest difference between accounting for dollars and accounting for Bitcoin. Even if you view your business entirely in terms of Bitcoin, you need to report the dollar value of each transaction on your taxes.
entries.englishValue: Some businesses choose to keep a portion of the Bitcoin they receive instead of auto-converting it all. If that's you, the main extra step is tracking your cost basis — the dollar value of each Bitcoin payment on the day you received it.
entries.currentValue: At spore anskaffelsesprisen bliver den største forskel mellem at føre regnskab i dollar og at føre regnskab i Bitcoin. Selvom du tænker på din virksomhed udelukkende i Bitcoin-termer, skal du rapportere dollarværdien for hver transaktion i din selvangivelse.
entries.targetTranslation: Nogle virksomheder vælger at beholde noget af den Bitcoin, de modtager, i stedet for automatisk at konvertere det hele. Hvis det er dig, er det ekstra trin at spore kostprisen — værdien i kroner på hver Bitcoin-betaling den dag, du modtog den.

entries.englishValueBefore: If you use QuickBooks, you can do this automatically using the Bitcoin Sync plugin.
entries.englishValue: Even if you think of your business entirely in Bitcoin, most tax authorities still want the dollar value reported. The good news: it's just two numbers per transaction — the amount of Bitcoin received and its dollar value on that day.
entries.currentValue: Hvis du bruger QuickBooks, kan du gøre dette automatisk med Bitcoin Sync-tilføjelsen.
entries.targetTranslation: Selv hvis du tænker på din forretning rent i Bitcoin, ønsker de fleste skattemyndigheder stadig, at du indberetter værdien i kroner. Den gode nyhed: det er bare to tal pr. transaktion — mængden af Bitcoin modtaget og dens værdi i kroner den dag.

entries.englishValueBefore: Inflation happens when more money is printed or created from thin air. This makes your money worth less over time.
entries.englishValue: Inflation happens when more money is printed or created from thin air. That makes the money in your pocket worth less over time — and it's why prices keep going up year after year.
entries.currentValue: Inflation opstår, når flere penge trykkes eller skabes ud af intet. Det gør dine penge mindre værd over tid.
entries.targetTranslation: Inflation sker, når der trykkes flere penge, eller når de skabes ud af den blå luft. Det får pengene i din lomme til at miste værdi over tid — og det er derfor priserne stiger år for år.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a fixed supply, which means no one can print more Bitcoin.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a fixed supply of 21 million coins. No government, bank, or company can print more of it. Your Bitcoin savings hold their value over time instead of quietly losing it.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin har en fast forsyningsgrænse, hvilket betyder, at ingen kan trykke flere Bitcoin.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin har en fast forsyning på 21 millioner mønter. Ingen regering, bank eller virksomhed kan trykke mere. Dine Bitcoin-opsparinger holder deres værdi over tid i stedet for stille at miste den.

entries.englishValueBefore: Multiple US banks have collapsed in the past few years due to bank runs.
entries.englishValue: Multiple U.S. banks have collapsed in recent years because of bank runs. When too many customers tried to withdraw at once, the banks didn't have the cash to pay everyone back.
entries.currentValue: Flere amerikanske banker er kollapset på grund af bankkriser i de seneste år.
entries.targetTranslation: I de seneste år er flere amerikanske banker krakket på grund af bankpaniker. Da for mange kunder prøvede at hæve på samme tid, havde bankerne ikke kontanter nok til at udbetale dem alle.

entries.englishValueBefore: Instead of just holding your money for you, banks invest and lend out your money. If those investments don't do well, they don't have enough to pay you back.
entries.englishValue: Instead of just holding your money, banks lend and invest most of it. If those investments go bad — or if depositors lose confidence — the bank can fail, and your deposits can be frozen or lost.
entries.currentValue: I stedet for bare at opbevare dine penge investerer bankerne dem og låner dem ud. Hvis disse investeringer ikke går godt, har de ikke nok penge til at give dig dine tilbage.
entries.targetTranslation: I stedet for bare at opbevare dine penge udlåner og investerer banker det meste. Hvis disse investeringer mislykkes — eller indskydere mister tilliden — kan banken krakke, og dine indlån kan fryses eller tabes.

entries.englishValueBefore: And the FDIC insurance fund only has $1 for every $100 they're insuring.
entries.englishValue: With Bitcoin, you can hold your own money directly in your own wallet. No bank. No intermediary. No bank run.
entries.currentValue: Og FDIC's forsikringsfond har kun 1 dollar for hver 100 dollar, det forsikrer.
entries.targetTranslation: Med Bitcoin kan du opbevare dine penge direkte i din egen wallet. Ingen bank. Ingen mellemmand. Ingen bankpanik.

entries.englishValueBefore: Unlike traditional financial networks, Bitcoin doesn't require permission to be used.
entries.englishValue: Unlike credit cards, PayPal, or traditional bank accounts, Bitcoin doesn't require anyone's permission to use.
entries.currentValue: I modsætning til traditionelle finansielle netværk kræver Bitcoin ingen tilladelse for at bruges.
entries.targetTranslation: I modsætning til kreditkort, PayPal eller traditionelle bankkonti kræver Bitcoin ikke nogens tilladelse.

entries.englishValueBefore: That means no one can stop you from using Bitcoin for any reason. It's the first financial network you can use without fear of censorship or seizure.
entries.englishValue: No one can freeze your account, block a payment, or cut you off from the network. It's the first financial system in history you can use freely, without fear of censorship or seizure.
entries.currentValue: Det betyder, at ingen kan forhindre dig i at bruge Bitcoin af nogen grund. Det er det første finansielle netværk, du kan bruge uden at bekymre dig om censur eller beslaglæggelse.
entries.targetTranslation: Ingen kan fryse din konto, blokere en betaling eller koble dig fra netværket. Det er det første finansielle system i historien, du kan bruge frit, uden frygt for censur eller konfiskation.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a misunderstood technology that is building a better world.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is often misunderstood, but it's quietly doing a lot of good in the world.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin er en misforstået teknologi, der bygger en bedre verden.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin bliver ofte misforstået, men gør stille meget godt i verden.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has enabled human rights activists to fight for freedom, reduced global methane emissions, saved national parks, and so much more.
entries.englishValue: It has helped human rights activists fight for freedom, reduced global methane emissions from landfills and oil fields, stabilized electric grids, and funded public goods like national parks.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin har gjort det muligt for menneskerettighedsaktivister at kæmpe for frihed, reduceret globale metanudledninger, reddet nationalparker og meget mere.
entries.targetTranslation: Det har hjulpet menneskerettighedsaktivister i deres kamp for frihed, reduceret globale metanudledninger fra lossepladser og oliefelter, stabiliseret elnet og finansieret offentlige goder som nationalparker.

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin at your business doesn't have to complicate your accounting. Here's the short version — plus the tools and pros to make it painless.
entries.targetTranslation: At acceptere Bitcoin i din virksomhed behøver ikke komplicere dit regnskab. Her er den korte version — plus værktøjer og eksperter, der gør det smertefrit.

entries.englishValue: If you already accept cash or card, adding Bitcoin to your business books is simpler than it looks. You have two paths: auto-convert every Bitcoin payment to dollars the moment it arrives (no new accounting needed), or keep some as Bitcoin (a few extra numbers to track).
entries.targetTranslation: Hvis du allerede modtager kontanter eller kort, er det nemmere end det lyder at tilføje Bitcoin til dit virksomhedsregnskab. entries.englishValue: Bitcoin gives your business a faster, cheaper, more private way to get paid. No middlemen. No chargebacks. No contracts. Just money that settles in seconds, directly from your customers to you.

entries.englishValue: Work through these resources at your own pace. Each one is a short, practical guide.

entries.englishValue: List your business for free on BTC Map — the open, worldwide directory of Bitcoin-accepting merchants — so Bitcoiners nearby can find you and spend Bitcoin at your business.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoiners actively look for places to spend. Getting your business on the map puts you in front of every Bitcoin user searching for somewhere to eat, shop, or stay nearby — at zero cost to you.

entries.englishValue: Let your customers know you accept Bitcoin. Order a free pack of 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' stickers to put up at your business.

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin is only half the job — your customers also need to know that you do. These small 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' stickers are designed to stick on your front door, register, menu, or anywhere else customers will see them before they pay.
entries.targetTranslation: At tage imod Bitcoin er kun halvdelen af arbejdet — dine kunder skal også vide, at du accepterer det. Disse små „Bitcoin modtages her“-klistermærker er designet til at sidde på din hoveddør, kasse, menu eller hvor som helst kunder vil se dem, før de betaler.

entries.englishValue: All Bitcoin wallets are interoperable — pick the one that fits your business. Free, instant settlement, no chargebacks.
entries.targetTranslation: Alle Bitcoin-wallets fungerer sammen — vælg den, der passer til din virksomhed. Gratis, øjeblikkelig afregning, ingen chargebacks.

entries.targetTranslation: Breez — Bitcoin-only Lightning-wallet

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin wallets are free. Pick one that fits your business — in-person, online, or invoice-based — and start accepting Bitcoin in minutes.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin-wallets er gratis. Vælg den, der passer til din virksomhed — personligt, online eller faktureret — og begynd at tage imod Bitcoin på få minutter.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for invoice-based businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Wallets til virksomheder, der fakturerer kunder

entries.englishValue: If you invoice clients (consulting, freelancing, B2B services), use a wallet built around invoicing. Your client pays a Bitcoin invoice in a couple of clicks.
entries.targetTranslation: Hvis du fakturerer kunder (rådgivning, freelance, B2B-tjenester), brug en wallet bygget omkring fakturering. Din kunde betaler Bitcoin-fakturaen med et par klik.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for businesses with multiple employees
entries.targetTranslation: Wallets til virksomheder med flere medarbejdere

entries.englishValue: If you have a team taking payments at the register, choose a wallet that supports multiple employee logins — so every employee gets their own PIN and you keep a clean audit trail of who took which payment.
entries.targetTranslation: Hvis du har et team, der tager imod betalinger i kassen, så vælg en wallet, der understøtter flere medarbejderlogin — så hver medarbejder får deres egen PIN, og du holder rene optegnelser over, hvem der tog imod hvilken betaling.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for online businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Wallets til onlinevirksomheder

entries.englishValue: Selling on a website? These wallets plug into your online store and accept Bitcoin from any customer, anywhere in the world — no chargebacks, no merchant account required.
entries.targetTranslation: Sælger du på nettet? Disse wallets kobles ind i din onlinebutik og tager imod Bitcoin fra enhver kunde overalt i verden — ingen chargebacks og ingen handelskonto nødvendig.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for individually-owned businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Wallets til enkeltmandsvirksomheder

entries.englishValue: If you run a shop, café, studio, or service on your own, any of these wallets will work. Pick based on whether you want to keep payments in Bitcoin or auto-convert part of each payment to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: Hvis du driver en butik, café, studie eller service på egen hånd, vil enhver af disse wallets fungere for dig. Vælg baseret på, om du vil beholde betalinger i Bitcoin eller automatisk konvertere noget af hver betaling til din lokale valuta.

entries.englishValue: Strike Business lets you accept Bitcoin and Lightning payments with zero fees and instant settlement. Supports in-person, online, and invoice-based payments with optional auto-conversion to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: Strike Business lader dig tage imod Bitcoin- og Lightning-betalinger med nul gebyrer og øjeblikkelig afregning. Det understøtter personlige, online- og fakturabetalinger med valgfri automatisk konvertering til din lokale valuta.

entries.englishValue: Lower fees, more for the business
entries.targetTranslation: Lavere gebyrer, mere til virksomheden

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments skip the banks and credit card companies that take 2–3% from every sale. The business keeps more of what you pay — which often means better prices and better service for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin-betalinger går uden om banker og kortselskaber, der tager 2-3 % af hvert salg. Virksomheden beholder mere af det, du betaler — hvilket ofte betyder bedre priser og bedre service for dig.

entries.englishValue: Instant settlement, no chargebacks
entries.targetTranslation: Øjeblikkelig afregning, ingen chargebacks

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments settle in seconds, directly from your wallet to the business. There's no waiting days for a bank to release funds, and no costly chargeback disputes — so the business can focus on serving customers instead of fighting fraud.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin-betalinger afregnes på sekunder, direkte fra din wallet til virksomheden. Ingen ventetid i dagevis, mens banken frigiver midler, og ingen dyre chargeback-tvister — hvilket betyder, at virksomheden kan fokusere på at betjene kunder i stedet for at bekæmpe svindel.

entries.englishValue: Free to accept, open to everyone
entries.targetTranslation: Gratis at tage imod, åbent for alle

entries.englishValue: There are no contracts, monthly fees, or setup costs for a business to accept Bitcoin. And millions of Bitcoin users around the world actively seek out merchants that accept it — giving this business free exposure to new customers.
entries.targetTranslation: Der er ingen kontrakter, månedlige gebyrer eller opstartsomkostninger for en virksomhed at tage imod Bitcoin. Og millioner af Bitcoin-brugere verden over leder aktivt efter handlende, der tager imod det — hvilket giver denne virksomhed gratis eksponering for nye kunder.

entries.targetTranslation: Ved at tage imod Bitcoin beholder denne virksomhed mere af hvert salg, bliver betalt øjeblikkeligt uden chargebacks og når et globalt publikum af Bitcoin-brugere — alt sammen uden kontrakter eller månedlige gebyrer.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin isn't just useful at the cash register — it's a better form of money that protects your savings, your privacy, and your freedom to transact. Here's a quick overview.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin er ikke kun nyttigt ved kassen — det er en bedre form for penge, der beskytter din opsparing, privatliv og frihed til at transagere. Her er en hurtig oversigt.

entries.englishValue: The business you're at accepts Bitcoin — a modern, open-source payment network that anyone can use, anywhere in the world, without banks or middlemen taking a cut.
entries.targetTranslation: Virksomheden, du er hos, tager imod Bitcoin — et moderne open source-betalingsnetværk, som alle hvor som helst i verden kan bruge, uden at banker og mellemmænd tager et snit.

entries.englishValue: What is Nostr?
entries.targetTranslation: Hvad er Nostr?

entries.englishValue: Nostr is similar to email: no one owns the protocol, anyone can build an app on top of it, and you can pick whichever app you like best. Unlike Twitter or Facebook, there's no central company that can censor, deplatform, or deboost you.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr minder om e-mail: protokollen er ikke ejet af nogen, hvem som helst kan bygge en app oven på den, og du vælger den, der passer bedst til dig. I modsætning til Twitter eller Facebook er der ingen central virksomhed, der kan censurere dig, forvise dig eller nedtone dig.
